toolbox_skcon5.source:
<xml id="toolbox_skcon5" style="display: none">

  <!-- skcon5 运动 -->

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_MOTION}" colour="#31ACFF">

    <!-- 端口 速度 -->

      <block type="motor">

        <value name="channel">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0</field>

          </shadow></value>       

        <value name="speed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">50</field>

          </shadow></value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!-- 端口 速度 时间-->

      <block type="motor_time">

        <value name="channel">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0</field>

          </shadow></value>       

        <value name="speed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">50</field>

          </shadow></value>

        <value name="time">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">2.5</field>

          </shadow></value>

      </block>   

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!-- 端口 端口 速度 时间 -->

      <block type="dual_motor_duration">      

        <field name="port_1">1</field>       

        <field name="port_2">2</field>        

        <value name="speed_1">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">80</field>

          </shadow></value>

          <value name="speed_2">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">80</field>

          </shadow></value>  

        <value name="time">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">2.5</field>

          </shadow></value>  

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!-- 编码器读数 xxx 停止 -->

      <block type="motor_angle">

        <value name="channel">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0</field>

          </shadow></value>       

        <value name="speed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">50</field>

          </shadow></value>

        <value name="angle">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">3200</field>

          </shadow></value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

       <!-- A~D % A~D % A~D Angle -->

      <block type="dual_motor_angle">

        <field name="port_1">1</field>

         <value name="speed_1">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">80</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>      

        <field name="port_2">2</field>

        <value name="speed_2">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">80</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>      

         <field name="port_3">1</field>        

        <value name="angle">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">3200</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>      

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!-- 电磁铁 -->

      <block type="set_electric_magnet">

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!-- 电机 反转 -->

      <block type="set_motor_reverse_open_loop">

      </block>

   </category>

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_OUTPUT}" colour="#009900">

      <!--<block type="setdo_led"></block>-->

      <block type="set_do"></block>

      <sep gap="32"></sep>

      <block type="printf_text"></block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="printf_number">

        <value name="data">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">100</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>        

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="printf">

        <value name="para1">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">100</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>  

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!-- 多行显示 -->

      <block type="printf_lines"></block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="printf_emoji"></block>

   </category>

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_SOUND_AND_LIGHT}" colour = "#CC66FF">

    <block type="play_sound"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="play_sound_until"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="record"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="set_coloured_light"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="set_smart_light"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="close_smart_light"></block>

   </category>

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_SENSOR}" colour="#99CC33">

    <block type="getai_glay"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="get_integrated_grayscale"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="getai_touch"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="getai_sonic"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="get_sonic_detect_object"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="getai_ir"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="get_flame"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="getai_temperature"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="get_humidity"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="get_magnetic"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="get_colour"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="getai_light"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="get_angle"></block>

    <sep gap="32"></sep>

    <block type="getencoder"></block>   

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="get_encoder_real_time_value"></block>   

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="resetencoder"></block> 

    <sep gap="32"></sep> 

    <block type="getai_mic"></block>

    <sep gap="32"></sep>

    <block type="getmotionsensor"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="get_motion_sensor_angular_velocity"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="resetmotionsensor"></block>

    <sep gap="32"></sep>

    <block type="getmseconds"></block>   

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="getmsecondsreset"></block>

    <sep gap="32"></sep>

    <block type="eeprom_read"></block>      

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="eeprom_write">

      <value name="data">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">100</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>  

    </block>

    <block type="get_aibychannel">

      <value name="NAME">

        <shadow type="math_number">

          <field name="NUM">1</field>

        </shadow>

      </value>      

    </block>

    <sep gap="32"></sep>

    <block type="getai_battery"></block>

    <sep gap="32"></sep>    

   </category>

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_LINE_PATROL}" colour="#009999">

      <block type="walkline_init">

        <field name="leftch">1</field>

        <field name="rightch">4</field>

        <field name="ch1">1</field>

        <field name="ch2">2</field>

        <field name="ch3">3</field>

        <field name="ch4">4</field>

        <field name="ch5">5</field>

      </block>

      <block type="walkline_init_integrated_grayscale">

        <field name="leftch">1</field>

        <field name="rightch">4</field>

        <field name="port">1</field>

      </block>

      <block type="walkline_floorsensor"></block>

   

       <block type="walkline_linewayc">

        <field name="type">1</field>

        <value name="speed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">60</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="time">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0.05</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

       </block>

       

       <block type="walkline_linewayt">

        <value name="speed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">60</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="time">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0.5</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

       </block> 

       <block type="walkline_lineway_e">

          <value name="speed">

            <shadow type="math_number">

              <field name="NUM">60</field>

            </shadow>

          </value>

          <field name="motor_port">0</field>

          <value name="encoder_value">

            <shadow type="math_number">

              <field name="NUM">3200</field>

            </shadow>

          </value>

       </block>

       <block type = "walkline_stop_until">

          <value name="speed">

            <shadow type="math_number">

              <field name="NUM">60</field>

            </shadow>

          </value>

          <value name="stop_condition">

            <shadow type="logic_boolean">

              <field name="NUM">true</field>

            </shadow>

            <block type="logic_compare">

              <field name="OP">LT</field>

              <value name="A">

                <shadow type="math_number">

                  <field name="NUM">10</field>

                </shadow>

                <block type="getai_glay"></block>

              </value>

              <value name="B">

                <block type="math_number">

                  <field name="NUM">1500</field>

                </block>

              </value>

            </block>

          </value>

       </block>      

       <block type="walkline_around">

        <value name="leftspeed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">20</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="rightspeed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">-20</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

       </block>

       <block type='walkline_start_motor_last'>

          <value name="left_speed">

            <shadow type="math_number">

              <field name="NUM">20</field>

            </shadow>

          </value>

          <value name="right_speed">

            <shadow type="math_number">

              <field name="NUM">20</field>

            </shadow>

          </value>

          <value name="duration">

            <shadow type="math_number">

              <field name="NUM">0.5</field>

            </shadow>

          </value>

       </block>

       <block type='wer_set_motor_e'>

          <value name="left_speed">

            <shadow type="math_number">

              <field name="NUM">20</field>

            </shadow>

          </value>

          <value name="right_speed">

            <shadow type="math_number">

              <field name="NUM">20</field>

            </shadow>

          </value>

          <field name="motor_port">0</field>

          <value name="encoder_value">

            <shadow type="math_number">

              <field name="NUM">3200</field>

            </shadow>

          </value>

       </block>

       <block type="walkline_motor_stop_until">

        <value name="leftspeed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">20</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="rightspeed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">20</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="stopbool">

          <shadow type="logic_boolean">

            <field name="NUM">true</field>

          </shadow>

          <block type="logic_compare">

            <field name="OP">LT</field>

            <value name="A">

              <shadow type="math_number">

                <field name="NUM">10</field>

              </shadow>

              <block type="getai_glay"></block>

            </value>

            <value name="B">

              <block type="math_number">

                <field name="NUM">1500</field>

              </block>

            </value>

          </block>

        </value>

       </block>

   </category>

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_AI}" colour="#FF6699">

    <block type="logic_compare">

        <field name="OP">EQ</field>

        <value name="A">

          <block type="get_camcode">

              <value name="time">

                <shadow type="math_number">

                  <field name="NUM">10</field>

                </shadow>

              </value>      

          </block>

        </value>

        <value name="B">

          <block type="block_conststring"></block>

        </value>

     </block>

     <sep gap="32"></sep>

     <block type="ai_learn"></block>

     <sep gap="8"></sep>

     <block type="ai_open"></block>

     <sep gap="8"></sep>

     <block type="ai_close"></block>

     <sep gap="8"></sep>

     <block type="ai_result"></block>

   </category>

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_CONTROL}" colour="#DC5252">

      <block type="wait">

        <value name="time">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">1</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="32"></sep>

      <block type="if">

        <value name="logic_val">

          <shadow type="logic_boolean">

            <field name="logic">true</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="ifelse">

        <value name="logic_val">

          <shadow type="logic_boolean">

            <field name="logic">true</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>      

      <sep gap="32"></sep>

      <block type="while_forver"></block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="while_number">

        <value name="TIMES">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">10</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>  

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="while_cmp">

        <value name="bool">

          <shadow type="logic_boolean">

            <field name="logic">true</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="wait_until">

        <value name="bool">

          <shadow type="logic_boolean">

            <field name="logic">true</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="while_break"></block>

      <!--

      <sep gap="32"></sep>

      <block type="logic_compare">

        <field name="OP">GT</field>

        <value name="A">

            <block type="getai_glay"></block>

        </value>

        <value name="B">

          <block type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">1500</field>

          </block>

        </value>

      </block>

      -->

    </category>

   

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_OPERATION}" colour="#FF9900">

      <block type="math_op">

        <value name="A">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">1</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="B">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">1</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="math_compare">

        <value name="A">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">1</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="B">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">1</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="logic_operation">

        <value name="A">

          <shadow type="logic_boolean">

            <field name="NUM">true</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="B">

          <shadow type="logic_boolean">

            <field name="NUM">true</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="logic_negate"></block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="logic_boolean"></block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!--

      <block type="math_single">

        <value name="NUM">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">9</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="math_trig">

        <value name="NUM">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">45</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="math_round">

        <value name="NUM">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">3.1</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      -->

      <block type = "robot_math_unary_operation">

        <value name="operand">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">9</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type = "robot_math_trigonometric_function">

        <value name="param">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">45</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type = "robot_math_rounding">

        <value name="param">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">3.1</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="abilix_math_number_property">

        <value name="NUMBER_TO_CHECK">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="math_modulo">

        <value name="DIVIDEND">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">64</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="DIVISOR">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">10</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="robot_math_random">

        <value name="FROM">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">1</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

        <value name="TO">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">100</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>

      </block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="math_number"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="block_conststring"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <!--

    <block type="math_constval"></block>

    -->

    <block type="robot_math_constants"></block>

   </category>

   

   <!-- 变量 sk5 -->

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_VARIABLE}" colour="#6666FF" custom="VARIABLE"> </category>

      

   <!-- 函数 sk5 -->

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_FUNCTION}" colour="#B69292" custom="PROCEDURE">

     <block type="function_call_noreturn"></block>

     <sep gap="32"></sep>           

   </category>

   <!--

   <category name="事件" colour="20">

      <block type="start"></block>

   </category>

   -->

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_COMMENT}" colour="#4A926E">

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="annotation"></block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="block_mod"></block>

      <sep gap="32"></sep>        

   </category>  

  </xml>

toolbox_skcon9.source:
<xml id="toolbox_skcon9" style="display: none">

  <!-- 运动 -->

	 <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_MOTION}" colour="#31ACFF">

      <block type="motor">

      	<value name="channel">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0</field>

          </shadow></value>     	

      	<value name="speed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">50</field>

          </shadow></value>

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!--  -->

			<block type="motor_time">

      	<value name="channel">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0</field>

          </shadow></value>     	

      	<value name="speed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">50</field>

          </shadow></value>

        <value name="time">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">2.5</field>

          </shadow></value>

      </block> 

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!-- 双电机持续时间 -->

      <block type="dual_motor_duration">      

        <field name="port_1">1</field>       

        <field name="port_2">2</field>        

        <value name="speed_1">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">80</field>

          </shadow></value>

          <value name="speed_2">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">80</field>

          </shadow></value>  

        <value name="time">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">2.5</field>

          </shadow></value>  

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <!-- 端口 速度  -->

    	<block type="motor_angle">

      	<value name="channel">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0</field>

          </shadow></value>     	

      	<value name="speed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">50</field>

          </shadow></value>

        <value name="angle">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">3200</field>

          </shadow></value>

      </block>

	 		<sep gap="8"></sep>

       <!-- 双电机 编码器 -->

     <block type="dual_motor_angle">

        <field name="port_1">1</field>

         <value name="speed_1">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">80</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>      

        <field name="port_2">2</field>

        <value name="speed_2">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">80</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>      

         <field name="port_3">1</field>        

        <value name="angle">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">3200</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>      

      </block>

       <sep gap="8"></sep> 

      <!-- 智能电机 端口 速度  角度 -->

	 		<block type="servoa_angle">

      	<value name="channel">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0</field>

          </shadow></value>     	

      	<value name="speed">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">50</field>

          </shadow></value>

        <value name="angle">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">0</field>

          </shadow></value>

      </block>

      <block type="set_electric_magnet">

      </block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

     

       <!--  -->

       <block type="set_motor_reverse_open_loop">

      </block>

	 </category>

	 <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_OUTPUT}" colour="#009900">

			<!--<block type="setdo_led"></block>-->

			<block type="set_do"></block>

			<sep gap="32"></sep>

			<block type="printf_text"></block>

			<sep gap="8"></sep>

			<block type="printf_number">

				<value name="data">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">100</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>				

			</block>

			<sep gap="8"></sep>

			<block type="printf">

				<value name="para1">

          <shadow type="math_number">

            <field name="NUM">100</field>

          </shadow>

        </value>	

			</block>

			<sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="printf_lines"></block>

      <sep gap="8"></sep>

      <block type="printf_emoji"></block>

	 </category>

   <category name="%{BKY_ABILIX_SCRATCH_CATEGORY_SOUND_AND_LIGHT}" colour = "#CC66FF">

    <block type="play_sound"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="play_sound_until"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="record"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>

    <block type="set_coloured_light"></block>

    <sep gap="8"></sep>
